releases.title: Homes, Rides, Nib Mail & Code Along
releases.subtitle: Move cities, collect dream rides, open funny dev emails, earn passive income & fix bugs live!

highlights.title: 5 Moveable Homes, Dream Rides & Room Tech
highlights.detail: Move to Brooklyn, San Francisco, Tokyo, or the Swiss Alps; collect 5 rides up to a Vintage 911; and add an OLED Ultrawide, Smart TV, Loft Bed & Desk Goldfish.

highlights.title: Passive Side-Project Income & Extra Coffee
highlights.detail: Launch 4 indie side projects that earn offline coins, and tap the coffee pill anytime to buy extra cups (up to 9!).

highlights.title: Nib Mail & Nostalgic Dev Events
highlights.detail: Read, reply to, and clear 18 randomized dev emails, plus enjoy surprise Hacker News, StackOverflow & Friday deploy popups.

highlights.title: Interactive Code Along, Heatmap & Studio Card
highlights.detail: Open the Code Along mini-IDE to squash bugs (-10s) or type lines (-4s), track your 28-day green heatmap, and share your Studio Card.

releases.title: Your Studio, Your Style
releases.subtitle: Remember the quiet joy of coding by hand — now with more projects, mascots, and a live studio.

highlights.title: 4 Male & Female Developer Mascots
highlights.detail: Pick Leo, Maya, Kai, or Zoe and personalize your studio terminal with an optional nickname.

highlights.title: Interactive Console & Live Monitor
highlights.detail: Open the collapsible terminal for project-specific logs & quick commands, or tap your monitor to switch screens.

highlights.title: 4 New Coding Projects
highlights.detail: Build a Lo-fi beat script, Cozy chatbot, Pocket app, and a Tiny OS from scratch.

highlights.title: Ranks, Streaks, Cat Petting & New Decor
highlights.detail: Climb developer ranks, keep a daily streak, tap your desk cat for purrs, and unlock the Espresso maker & Fairy lights.
